player_prompt.intro:
Uyiyithemba {player_id} kwiHighSociety (igame yabini). 
Umthombo wemidlalo:  Amaqela amathathu anethemba athetha ukuthengwa ngokulandelana.
Ukuthenga:    Ngokuthengwa, khetha iqela elinganiselwe ngokulindelwe 1-11 bese ivalwe.
            • Ukuthenga okuphezulu kunqabela iqela lethemba kanti lithathele iqela elinganiselwe.
            • Ukuthenga oludala lithathe iqela elinganiselwe.
            • Kungaba nokuthi zonke zithengwe zibuyiselwe kanti iqela lethemba siye sithengwe futhi.
Ukubala:    Emva kothengwa konke, yala **imali engapheli + iziponti zothemba**.
            Inani eliphakeme *net-worth* linqabile (kungaba ukuphelenyana -> kudlalwe).

**Isintaksu yokwenza**  →  bida iqela elilodwa njenge'[7]' noma '[11]'.
